purpose: Non-decisional ambiguity-envelope kill-screen. Determine whether DH-03 is obviously incompatible, obviously robust to the published Kraken carry ambiguity, or remains source-insufficient. This cannot produce PROP-COMPAT-PASS, CONDITIONAL-PASS, purchase authorization or live-trading authorization.

source.unresolved_trade_policy: Exclude the two official execution-path-unresolved rows exactly as in Phase5; no imputation.

account_model.risk_basis: current account equity immediately before entry cost

LEGAL_DAILY_0000.rule: If position is open at 00:00 UTC, debit full daily rate at 00:00 UTC.
LEGAL_DAILY_0000.authority: Breakout Evaluation Agreement Annex A updated 2026-08-27

SUPPORT_4H_PHASE_SWEEP.rule: Six equal installments every four hours. Exact phase offset is unpublished.
SUPPORT_4H_PHASE_SWEEP.phase_offsets: Exhaustive minute-level sweep of offsets 0..239 minutes from 00:00 UTC; each offset defines six rollover times per 24h.
SUPPORT_4H_PHASE_SWEEP.reporting: For every Plan x Risk x Execution cell report best-case and worst-case decision across all 240 support timing offsets; do not select a favorable offset.

risk_rules.mdl_floor: balance at 00:30 UTC minus 3% of initial balance
risk_rules.mdd_floor: initial balance minus plan MDD percentage
risk_rules.profit_target: realized balance target; no consistency rule and no time limit

mark_to_market.primary_path: frozen Binance USD-M 1m price path as non-exact price proxy
mark_to_market.daily_reference: synchronized 1m open at 00:30 UTC for balance-reference event and synchronized 1m close for intraday equity checks
mark_to_market.entry_stop_target_exit: Preserve exact DH-03 entry/stop/target/max-hold timestamps and execution semantics from official ledger; price path is used for portfolio floating equity only.

classification.OBVIOUS_PROXY_BREACH: All relevant carry interpretations for a frozen Plan x Risk x Execution cell breach before target.
classification.ROBUST_PROXY_SURVIVOR_EXACT_REPLAY_STILL: Legal daily path reaches target without breach and every one of the 240 support 4h phase offsets also reaches target without breach.
classification.AMBIGUITY_MATERIAL: Published carry interpretations or support timing offsets change pass/breach outcome.
classification.PROXY_INSUFFICIENT: Required pinned source cannot be evaluated without a new assumption.

post_run_policy: Report all plans and all frozen risk/execution cells. Do not rank plans or risks. Exact PROP-COMPAT Phase3 remains locked regardless of proxy result.
